I've tried many dance forms in the past, but today I have realized that nothing and no dance form has made me feel as beautiful & powerful as what bellydance has made me feel ❤. Don’t hesitate about your age, your body, about anything- just join.
This isn’t just dance… it’s therapy in motion. 💃✨
In one line -
These belly dance classes are a total confidence booster shots 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Fashionby Sim
featured_reviews.review_text:
This belly dance class has honestly become one of the best parts of my week. The teacher pays so much attention to every small detail — seriously, her observation is too good. She notices the tiniest things and helps each of us improve. She really works on every student individually, and I really appreciate that.

The learning space she gives us is also very nice — very open, very positive. Yahan hum sirf dance nahi seekhte… we learn, we improve, we laugh. I’ve grown a lot in terms of confidence because of this class. Belly dance ke through I feel more connected to myself, and that feels really good.

And I have to say, my batchmates are amazing. I feel like I’ve found such good people here — even good friends. Dancing with them makes the class even more fun.

Overall, this class has given me growth, happiness, and a lot of comfort. I really enjoy coming here, and I’m very grateful to the teacher for creating such a warm and supportive space.

featured_reviews.name: Andrew Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Energy is something that means everything to me and this class has the right energy for me ❤ . Then I would say the music and the teaching style are unmatched. All steps are broken down so clearly that even a beginner feels confident within the first session. Energy of the class is not just fun and feminine but empowering as well — you don’t just learn belly dance, you learn grace, posture, rhythm and body awareness.

The instructor pays personal attention to each student & brings out the best in every one.
I look forward to every class — it’s my favourite part of the week! 💃🩷

featured_reviews.review_text: Have reached level 11. Doing the professional choreography currently and feeling awesome. I have enjoyed learning here. I eventually to intend to also teach belly dance someday myself and I will start my teachers training course also very soon here with Ritambhara ma'am. I definitely recommend this class to anyone who loves this dance form as its taught perfectly well here.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Tanya Mohan
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been to other belly dance classes near me but somehow din't connect anywhere. I tried this class and I have stuck here and currently I am on level 4. So, what I primarily love about this class is the pace at which Rita mam teaches. It's only me who calls her Rita ( Ritambhara). I understood each and every technique in a new light and I finally understood the belly dance techniques and came more closer to the dance art. My foundation in belly dancing has become really strong because of the way its taught. Also I'm so happy with my belly dancing belt. They taught me how to choose a belt that was appropriate for me which no other teacher ever taught me. The sound of the belt motivates me so much and makes my learning better. In each and every class I assure you each and every person will get the personal attention they need from the teacher and the practice is so awesome. I also achieved my hand and leg  coordination which I achieved no where in the previous belly dance classes. Also I'm so happy that I was also taught how to dance to a Shakira song apart from other belly dance songs. Of course I have to be better than what I am today and I know I can acheive it just here at these belly dance classes in Mumbai. I do recommend ❤️

featured_reviews.name: confetti confetti
featured_reviews.review_text: I really like the belly dance classes here essentially because of the personalised attention I'm getting from the teacher. I'm liking the fact that if I make any mistake its understood and rectified then and there. Definitely the way belly dance is taught here is very stimulating for me. I am also having fun at the same time. I would like to add that belly dance has really made me feel very confident about my body. I have build amazing confidence with this dance form. Almost done with level 1 and looking forward to level 2. 💃💃

featured_reviews.name: Mitu Daga
featured_reviews.review_text:
Belly Dancing at Belly Dance Institute Mumbai has been an experience beyond just learning—it’s a journey of self-expression, confidence, and joy. Each class is a blend of fun, engagement, and discovery, where learning feels effortless and every technique is enjoyed to its fullest.

The instructor is calm, humorous, and very knowledgeable. She breaks down even the most intricate movements into their simplest forms, which has made learning so easy. Not just a teacher, but she is a mentor, a guru, and a friend, radiating warmth, positivity, and kindness that makes my energy uplifting and positive.

A sense of connection—not just with dance but with my own feminine energy is what I feel here. Every session feels meditative, allowing me to embrace grace, strength, and rhythm in a way that is both empowering and transformative.

Grateful 🙏 to have found this institute and the happiness it brings into my life. If you’re looking for more than just a belly dance class—if you seek an experience that nurtures your body, mind, and spirit—Belly Dance Institute Mumbai is the place to be.

It's not just about picking a song and dancing to it (though that's a part of it, of course), it's about learning various advanced dance techniques through every dance session, and then progressing to the next level.
3. Kiran Shenvi Sir is the heart and soul of the institution, and his passion for dance trickles down to the entire team of teachers. He personally teaches many classes, and is usually around to supervise other classes conducted by his team.
4. The entire team is very friendly and welcoming. It feels like home for the kids. They just love going to class.
5. The setup is preferable to other celebrity dance schools with branches all over, where it's highly unlikely you'll ever get to learn under the founding teacher.
6. Their studio is newly renovated with a wonderful ambience that makes you wanna dance.
7. My daughter's dance skills have greatly improved.
Overall, when I was looking for dance classes for my daughter over a year back and took some trials in my area, Shenvi School of Dance really stood out. And today, after a year, we're really happy we chose this school.
